simple.meaning: שֶׁבַע (shebaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times ; by implication, a week ; by extension, an indefinite number.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 394 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, beginning at Genesis 4:24. Its contexts include family, family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁבַע (H7651).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שֶׁבַע (shebaʻ) / H7651 is traced through Genesis 4:24, Genesis 5:7, Genesis 5:25, Genesis 5:26 as a generated source-based concept entry.
